262: Rabbi Abba said: Wine, oil, and water came from the same place. Water and oil are on the right. The priests took them and inherited them. But oil is better than all. As it is joy [at] the beginning and at the end, as it is written: It is like fine oil on the head, running down onto the beard, the beard of Aaron (Psalms 133:2). And wine is on the left. The Levites inherited it for the raising of the voice and for song, but not to be silent. As wine is never for silence, but oil is always discreet.

What is the difference between this and that? It is only that oil, which is discreet, is always whispered; it comes from the place of thought, which is always whispering and is never heard. And that is discreet, and that is why it is on the right. But wine, which is for the raising of the voice and is never silent, comes from the side of the Mother [Ima]. And the Levites inherit it from the left side, and it acts for song and for the raising of the voice, and it acts for judgment. And that is why it is written: and by their word shall every controversy and every blemish be [decided] (Deuteronomy 21:5).

Because of this, when a priest goes up to the Temple to do the service, it is forbidden for him to drink wine. As they serve with discretion, and they discreetly come and concentrate, and they pair the one that needs to be paired and bring down blessings to all of the world. But it is all discreet, and they do all of these [things] in secret. Whereas wine reveals secrets, as all of its works act for the raising of the voice.
